title: Asymmetric orbital hybridization at the MXene–VO2−x interface stabilizes oxygen vacancies for enhanced reversibility in aqueous zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,367-377
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04466E, Paper
Yuan Fang, Chunhong Qi, Weichao Bao, Fangfang Xu, Wei Sun, Bin Liu, Xiqian Yu, Lianjun Wang, Wan Jiang, Pengpeng Qiu, Wei Luo
The MXene–VO2−x cathode with asymmetric Ti–O–V orbital hybridization at the heterointerface for zinc-ion batteries is designed to stabilize the oxygen vacancies through charge transfer, thus efficiently boosting the electrochemical performance.
